no_adcom_quote.quote: This NDA was not referred for review to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee because outside expertise was not necessary as there were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion. Specifically, the clinical study design was acceptable and the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues in the intended population.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the original GILOTRIF (afatinib) NDA201292 approval. The Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Office Director memo all state the application was not referred to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee because there were no controversial issues warranting outside expertise; the clinical review team instead conferred informally with three special government employees (two lung-cancer subject-matter experts and a patient representative). Because no AC meeting occurred, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
